description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ganegoda, Elpitiya D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 810734 (23/0298)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their locations, extents, ownership details (all owned by "The State"), and maintenance arrangements. The content focuses entirely on land registration, property ownership determinations, and cadastral mapping - all core elements of land administration that fall under the Land Gazettes classification.
